name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Set the bar across your upper traps and pull your elbows down into it.
Unrack, step back, and place your feet a little wider than shoulder width.
Take a big breath, brace your midsection, and sit down between your hips.
Drive the floor away and stand tall to finish the rep.

name: Barbell Front Squat
instructions: Rack the bar across your front delts with your elbows high.
Brace, then sit straight down keeping your torso as upright as you can.
Drive up while keeping the elbows lifted.

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold one bell at chest height with both hands.
Sit down between your hips, letting your elbows travel inside your knees.
Stand back up without letting the weight drift forward.

name: Machine Hack Squat
instructions: Set your shoulders under the pads and your feet mid-platform.
Release the safeties, then lower under control until your thighs pass parallel.
Press back up without locking out hard.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Sit with your back flat against the pad and feet shoulder width on the platform.
Lower until your knees reach about 90 degrees, keeping your lower back down.
Press the platform away without snapping your knees straight.
cues: lower back stays on the pad

name: Dumbbell Squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Brace and sit down between your hips until your thighs are at least parallel.
Stand up and squeeze your glutes at the top.

name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Stand with feet about shoulder width, toes slightly out.
Sit down between your hips with your arms reaching forward for balance.
Stand back up under control.

name: Barbell Deadlift
instructions: Set the bar over your mid-foot and take a shoulder-width grip.
Drop your hips until your shins touch the bar and pull your chest up.
Take the slack out of the bar, then push the floor away.
Stand tall, then return the bar along the same path.
cues: squeeze the glutes at the top

name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Start standing with the bar at your hips.
Push your hips back and let the bar slide down your thighs with soft knees.
Stop when your hamstrings will not lengthen further, then drive your hips forward.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Push your hips back, keeping the weights close to your legs.
Stand up by driving your hips forward.

name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Stand with the bell a forearm's length in front of you.
Hike it back between your legs, then snap your hips forward.
Let the bell float to chest height and guide it back down.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench and the bar across your hips.
Drive through your heels until your torso and thighs form a straight line.
Lower under control without resting the bar down.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and heels close to your hips.
Push through your heels and lift your hips until you are in a straight line.
Lower slowly and repeat.

name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Set the pad just above your ankles and the knee joint at the machine's pivot.
Curl your heels underneath you as far as the machine allows.
Return slowly, resisting the whole way.

name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
instructions: Anchor your ankles and kneel on a soft surface.
Keeping a straight line from knee to shoulder, lower yourself forward slowly.
Catch yourself with your hands and push back to the start.
cues: resist as long as you can
small range is fine at first

name: Back Extension
instructions: Set the pad just below your hip bones.
Fold forward at the hips with a long spine.
Lift back up until your body is in a straight line and stop there.

name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie back with your eyes under the bar and set your shoulder blades down and back.
Unrack and bring the bar over your lower chest.
Lower it to touch your chest, then press it back over your shoulders.
cues: push yourself away from the bar

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie back with a dumbbell in each hand over your shoulders.
Lower until your upper arms are just past your torso.
Press back up and stop just short of the bells touching.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Set the bench to about 30 degrees and take the bells to your shoulders.
Press up and slightly back over your upper chest.
Lower under control to the same depth every rep.

name: Machine Chest Press
instructions: Set the seat so the handles line up with your mid chest.
Press out until your elbows are almost straight.
Return until you feel a stretch across your chest.

name: Push-Up
instructions: Set your hands slightly wider than your shoulders and your body in one line.
Lower until your chest is a fist's height from the floor.
Push the floor away and lock your elbows at the top.
cues: one line from head to heels

name: Knee Push-Up
instructions: Kneel with your hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Keep a straight line from knees to shoulders and lower your chest to the floor.
Push back up to straight arms.

name: Decline Push-Up
instructions: Put your feet on a bench and your hands on the floor.
Keep one line from heels to head and lower your chest to the floor.
Press back to straight arms.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Take a shoulder-width grip on the bar.
Lower it to your lower chest keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Press back up and squeeze your triceps at the top.
cues: touch the same spot every rep

name: Cable Chest Fly
instructions: Set both pulleys at chest height and take a staggered stance.
With a soft elbow angle, bring your hands together in front of your sternum.
Let your arms travel back until you feel a stretch across the chest.

name: Dumbbell Chest Fly
instructions: Lie back holding the bells over your chest with soft elbows.
Open your arms until you feel a stretch across the chest.
Bring them back together without pressing.

name: Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge forward to about 45 degrees with the bar hanging at arm's length.
Pull the bar to your lower ribs, leading with your elbows.
Lower under control without letting your torso rise.

name: Dumbbell Row
instructions: Brace one hand on a bench and let the dumbbell hang.
Pull it to your hip, keeping your shoulders square.
Lower all the way to a full stretch.

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit tall with a slight forward lean at the start.
Pull the handle to your navel and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Let the handle travel back until you feel a stretch.

name: Inverted Row
instructions: Set a bar at hip height and hang underneath it with straight arms.
Keep one line from heels to head and pull your chest to the bar.
Lower slowly to straight arms.

name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
instructions: Lie chest-down on an inclined bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Row the bells to your ribs with your elbows at about 45 degrees.
Lower to a full stretch each rep.

name: Band Row
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and step back until it is taut.
Pull the handles to your ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Return slowly against the band's pull.

name: Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip a little wider than your shoulders.
Pull your elbows down to your ribs until your chin clears the bar.
Lower all the way to straight arms.

name: Chin-Up
instructions: Hang with an underhand shoulder-width grip.
Pull until your chin passes the bar and your chest touches it.
Lower under control to full extension.

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Set the thigh pad so you stay seated and take a wide overhand grip.
Pull the bar to your collarbone with a slight backward lean.
Let the bar rise until your lats are fully stretched.

name: Band Lat Pulldown
instructions: Anchor a band overhead and kneel underneath it.
Pull the handles down and out to your shoulders.
Return slowly to a full overhead stretch.

name: Barbell Overhead Press
instructions: Take the bar at collarbone height with your forearms vertical.
Brace your midsection and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bar overhead and move your head through at the top.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit or stand with the bells at shoulder height, palms forward.
Press overhead until your elbows are almost straight.
Lower to ear height under control.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
instructions: Set the seat so the handles start at shoulder height.
Press overhead without shrugging.
Return until you feel a stretch in the front of the shoulder.

name: Pike Push-Up
instructions: Start in a downward-dog position with your hips high.
Lower the crown of your head toward the floor between your hands.
Press back up to straight arms.

name: Dip
instructions: Support yourself on parallel bars with your arms straight.
Lean forward slightly and lower until your upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.

name: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step forward and lower until your back knee is just off the floor.
Drive through the front foot into the next step.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Put your back foot on a bench and your front foot a stride ahead.
Lower straight down until your back knee is just off the floor.
Drive through the front heel to stand.

name: Barbell Lunge
instructions: Set the bar on your upper traps as for a back squat.
Step forward and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Push back to the start with the front leg.

name: Step-Up
instructions: Set a box at about knee height.
Place one whole foot on the box and stand up without pushing off the back leg.
Lower under control to the floor.
cues: no push off the back foot

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Raise them out to shoulder height with a slight bend in the elbow.
Lower slowly all the way down.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Set the pulley low and stand side-on with the handle in the far hand.
Raise the handle out to shoulder height.
Lower under constant tension.

name: Band Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand on the middle of a band with a handle in each hand.
Raise your arms out to shoulder height.
Lower slowly against the band.

name: Dumbbell Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Hinge forward until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor.
With soft elbows, sweep the bells out to the sides.
Lower under control.

name: Cable Face Pull
instructions: Set the pulley just above head height with a rope.
Pull the rope toward your forehead, splitting your hands apart.
Return under control.

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
instructions: Hold the bells in front of your thighs.
Raise one or both to shoulder height with straight-ish arms.
Lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl
instructions: Stand with the bells at your sides, palms forward.
Curl to shoulder height without moving your elbows.
Lower all the way to straight arms.

name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Hold the bar at shoulder width with an underhand grip.
Curl it to your chest keeping your elbows at your sides.
Lower under control to straight arms.

name: Cable Curl
instructions: Set the pulley low and take the bar with an underhand grip.
Curl up while keeping your elbows at your sides.
Resist on the way down.

name: Band Curl
instructions: Stand on the band with a handle in each hand.
Curl to your shoulders keeping your elbows still.
Lower slowly against the band.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Hold one bell overhead with both hands.
Lower it behind your head by bending only your elbows.
Press back to straight arms.

name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Set the pulley high and take the bar or rope at chest height.
Push down to straight arms keeping your elbows at your sides.
Let the handle rise until your forearms pass parallel.

name: Bench Dip
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench and slide your hips off with hands beside you.
Lower until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Press back to straight arms.

name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand with the balls of your feet on a step.
Let your heels drop below the step for a full stretch.
Press up as high as you can and pause.

name: Dumbbell Calf Raise
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand on a step.
Drop your heels for a stretch, then rise onto your toes.
Pause at the top before lowering.

name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Set the pad across your lower thighs with the balls of your feet on the platform.
Let your heels sink, then press up as high as you can.
Pause and lower slowly.

name: Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and hands by your temples.
Curl your ribs toward your hips and lift your shoulder blades off the floor.
Lower slowly.
cues: curl, do not yank the neck

name: Hanging Knee Raise
instructions: Hang from a bar with straight arms.
Curl your knees up toward your chest, tilting your pelvis at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.

name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Kneel below a high pulley holding a rope beside your head.
Crunch your ribs toward your hips, rounding your upper back.
Return under control.

name: Barbell Shrug
instructions: Hold the bar at arm's length in front of your thighs.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause and lower under control.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Shrug straight up and hold for a beat.
Lower all the way down.

name: Dumbbell Wrist Curl
instructions: Rest your forearms on your thighs with your palms up.
Let the bells roll to your fingertips, then curl your wrists up.
Lower slowly.

name: Farmer's Carry
instructions: Pick up a heavy weight in each hand.
Stand tall with your shoulders back and walk a set distance.
Set the weights down under control.
